title: The Hottest New AI Chatbot Is Just a Guy Answering Your Questions
summary: But Bryant says he didn’t create ChatTJB to make money. “I really just want people to have an opportunity to take a second look at both their own relationship to technology as well as the world's relationship to technology,” Bryant says.
